method.name: SetSharingMode
method.summary: Enables or disables sharing a graphics device between Silverlight and XNA.

overload.summary: Enables or disables sharing a graphics device between Silverlight and XNA.

parameters.parameter: Set to true to enable, and false to disable XNA rendering within a Silverlight application. XNA rendering is disabled by default for Silverlight applications.

overload.remarks: SetSharingMode should be set to true before attempting to render with XNA, and should be set to false when rendering is completed, returning control of the graphics device to Silverlight.
